scientific_integrity: Explicit full cochain differentials and cup generators give an arbitrary-field proof; finite-field exhaustive checks corroborate but do not certify an infinite theorem. Earlier bracket-isomorphism classifications and H0 computations are not presented as new.

title: Three modular Poisson-cohomology rings on the square-zero coordinate plane
